title: ר' יוחנן בן קצרתה

paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan ben Katzarta, in Rabbi Yonah’s name: Midrash Chazit, on ‘My beloved is like a gazelle.’ In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, Ellu Devarim 8:6:4 (cited here as halakhah 7): DeKatzrinon, in Rabbi Nachum bar Simai’s name; see Menachem bar Simai. At the end of Mashilin: DeKatzinan. There is also a Rabbi Yose ben Katzart. Rabbi Yitzchak ben Katzart in Rabbi Yonah’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Rosh Hashanah 1:1, and Midrash Shmuel 26:5 (cited here as chapter 29). Perhaps it is a scribal error.
